verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents an API parameter for scheduling future delivery, and nothing shows a way to cancel a scheduled message. The only nearby items are adjacent: the n8n integration's 'schedule' wording describes a third-party no-code workflow tool, and 'Send time optimization' is a different feature. Neither counts as the product's own schedule-and-cancel API capability.

support.subject: As a developer, I can schedule an email for future delivery through the API and cancel it before it goes out
